commit.message:
ohos: Write the font cache atomically (#48542)

Writes the OHOS font cache to a temporary file that is then renamed into
place.

Testing: No automated tests for OHOS; type-checked under `--cfg
ohos_mock` and exercised the write, read and cleanup paths in a local
harness.

Fixes: #48501
